answer.says: Ramesh, my stomach protests the abstraction of my contemplation. Prepare the omelette, toast, and tea. The body must be satisfied before it can serve the spirit.
answer.thought: Hunger is the most immediate negation of the spirit; one cannot philosophize on an empty stomach. I shall command Ramesh to prepare the meal, for even the most rigorous system requires material sustenance.
